lichControllerStrategy: When native synced shields remain, hold the sword, aim at visible bolts from approximately 12 blocks and click only within native 3-block crosshair reach. This is an automated control strategy, not a change to boss shields or projectile behavior.
nativeArenaLimitations: The native corpse/ragdoll mods can leave prior player-death remains in the reused arena. Visible remains can affect approaches or collisions and are a disclosed fixture/modpack limitation; no active encounter is altered to remove them.
Automated controller outcomes are observations, not estimates of human win rates. Input requests alone do not prove a successful shield block or reflected Lich bolt.
Natural boss AI and protected-phase rules remain native; no HP/damage validation claim implies that every phase appeared in each bounded client encounter.

nativeGetUpAssistance.reason: Native nonlethal Sable ragdoll can leave the player seated when auto-expiry is disabled; the automated controller did not supply the ordinary get-up key
nativeGetUpAssistance.allowedAction: Logged ordinary native get-up input only; no health, cooldown, movement-velocity, boss-state or configuration reset during combat
nativeGetUpAssistance.interpretation: These bounded outcomes include controller-limited exposure and are not full autonomous fight completion. Later native get-up assistance must be disclosed with its input log.
nativeGetUpAssistance.observedRecovery: Monstrosity native crouch get-up at 2026-11-05T02:50:04.545Z preserved health 19.698448; another ordinary crouch toggle at 02:50:12 restored standing. This was nonlethal recovery, not revival or a health reset.

nativeStateTerminology.nonlethalDown: Native ragdoll/down state: ordinary crouch input can get the player up; not a defeat by itself
nativeStateTerminology.lethalKnockout: RagRevival lethal knockout requiring revival; harness machine outcome lost_downed is based on the native lethal event and remains a defeat. Replacement/healing can leave nonzero HP (case 37 ended at 2 HP), so HP alone is not the definition.
nativeStateTerminology.betweenCaseCleanup: kill BossPlaytest is permitted only after a recorded lethal knockout while the next encounter waits for native respawn; never used as nonlethal mid-fight recovery
